Plate appears to be about 20 cm (a side plate), with a diameter of roughly 360 px in the image, so about 18 px per cm.

Bacon: two strips, each about 17 cm long (~300 px, though foreshortened), so roughly 15 cm. They are cooked and thin. A cooked strip weighs about 8 g, so two come to about 16 g.

Hash browns: the patch is about 190 x 200 px, roughly 10 x 11 cm, and about 1.5 cm thick. That gives roughly 100 cm³ at a loose density, about 80 g of shredded potatoes.

Salsa or pico de gallo: it covers about half of the hash brown area, around 5 cm across, and is 1 cm thick. That is roughly 40 g.

Oil and sauce: the hash browns look a bit oily, so I'll add about 4 g of oil.
